# Force Rebuild

![](../../assets/icons/force-rebuild.svg){ .tool-icon }
Rebuilds every feature from scratch.
{ .tool-lead }

Force Rebuild rebuilds every feature from scratch, not only the ones that changed. Use it when something looks out of date.

## How to use it

1. Click **Force Rebuild**.

## Good to know

- It can take a while on a big part. [What's Wrong](whats-wrong.md) has a **Rebuild All** button too.

## Where to find it

- The **Evaluate** toolbar.
- **Solid Design** → **Evaluate** → **Force Rebuild**
- **Tools** → **Evaluate** → **Force Rebuild**
- Command search: press <kbd>/</kbd> in the 3D view and type its name.
